description: a ring torus, R 5 and r 2 about z, in common with a slab 3.6 ≤ x ≤ 4.4 parallel to its axis: each side plane meets the torus in one spiric oval, traced in the torus's own parameter plane and fitted (ADR-0019), that crosses both of the torus's seams twice — the tube circle in the profile plane and the outer equator — so the band of the torus between the ovals is four faces, as Open CASCADE's is. The first boolean a whole torus face, periodic both ways, is an operand of. inertia_rel is stated at 3e-9 because the oracle's own solid is the far side: a quadrature of the closed integrand ∫ 2√(r² − (ρ − R)²) ρ Δφ(ρ) dρ to thirty digits gives the volume 31.7783690362 and I_xx 343.297474063, from which Arris is 1.8e-10 and 7e-11 and Open CASCADE's own build — its section edges at 1e-6 — 3.5e-10 and 1.3e-9
